title: Null sets, level sets and local finiteness of slices from the co-area identity (Simon Ch. 6, 4.1–4.2 with special g)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, f : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel and G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P Borel. Write Hᵏ := μHE[k] and assume the co-area identity (CF): for every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], the function t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ is Lebesgue-a.e.-measurable on ℝ and ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)} g dHⁿ dt = ∫_M |G| g dH^{n+1}. Then: (a) (null sets) if a property p holds at H^{n+1}-a.e. point of M, then for L¹-a.e. t it holds at Hⁿ-a.e. point of M ∩ f⁻¹(t); (b) (level sets) for every c ∈ ℝ, G(x) = 0 for H^{n+1}-a.e. x ∈ M with f(x) = c; (c) (local finiteness) if g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] is Borel and ∫_{M∩K} |G| g dH^{n+1} < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, then for L¹-a.e. t, ∫_{M∩f⁻¹(t)∩K} g dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P.
